description: We are team Sky Piercers, we will build a Health Monitoring system for astronaut, join our team if you have strong hardware, software and coding skills.
summary:
ASTRA-VITAL is a proposed astronaut health-monitoring platform designed to support physical and psychological well-being during long-duration space missions. It integrates health indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, mood, glucose and body temperature into one dashboard.

Using personalised baselines, trend analysis and explainable anomaly detection, it identifies unusual health changes and provides colour-coded alerts with recommended actions. Its six modules cover health monitoring, symptom reporting, analytics, alerts, medical guidance and offline access.

Grounded in NASA research, ASTRA-VITAL combines publicly available research data with clearly labelled synthetic data for demonstration. Its ultimate goal is to make astronaut health monitoring simpler, smarter and more accessible while supporting informed decisions and professional medical oversight.
